entry.title: Rewriting our CLI in Rust & TypeScript
entry.summary: We moved our command-line tool from Python to Rust for speed, and kept a TypeScript SDK for plugins.
entry.content: Rust gave us predictable performance. The code is at atom-example/fast-cli. Rust also made cross-compiling easy.
